Curated human transcription factors and their classifications

Source: R/data.R
human_tfs.Rd

Human TFs curated by Lambert et al. (2018), classified with the CIS-BP and TFClass schemes. As this list was manually curated by experts, it is more accurate than TFs identified from the human proteome with annotate_domains() and classify_tfs(), and it can be used as the set of human TFs in comparative analyses (e.g., with get_tf_counts()). CIS-BP families were obtained from CIS-BP (build 3.10), whose human TFs are the TFs in this list. TFClass classifications were obtained from TFClass for TFs in TFClass, and inferred from CIS-BP families (as in classify_tfs()) for other TFs.

Usage

data(human_tfs)

Format

A data frame with one row per TF and the following variables:

Gene

Ensembl gene ID (or UniProt entry name, for DUX1 and DUX3, which are not in Ensembl).

Symbol

HGNC gene symbol.

CISBP_family

TF family according to CIS-BP. TFs without a known DNA-binding domain are in family 'Unknown'.

TFClass_superclass

TF superclass according to TFClass.

TFClass_class

TF class according to TFClass.

TFClass_family

TF family according to TFClass.

TFClass_source

Source of TFClass classifications. One of 'TFClass' (TF classified by TFClass) or 'Inferred from CIS-BP' (TFClass classifications inferred from the CIS-BP family). NA for TFs without TFClass classifications.

DBD

DNA-binding domain(s), as in Lambert et al. (2018).

TF_assessment

Assessment of DNA-binding activity. One of 'Known motif', 'Inferred motif' (motif inferred from a closely related TF), or 'Likely to be sequence specific TF'.

Binding_mode

Mode of interacting with DNA. One of 'Monomer or homomultimer', 'Obligate heteromer', or 'Low specificity DNA-binding protein'.

Motif_status

Availability of DNA-binding motifs. One of 'High-throughput in vitro', '100 perc ID - in vitro' (motif available for a TF with an identical DNA-binding domain), 'In vivo/Misc source', or 'No motif'.

References

Lambert, S. A., Jolma, A., Campitelli, L. F., Das, P. K., Yin, Y., Albu, M., ... & Weirauch, M. T. (2018). The human transcription factors. Cell, 172(4), 650-665.

Weirauch, M. T., Yang, A., Albu, M., Cote, A. G., Montenegro-Montero, A., Drewe, P., ... & Hughes, T. R. (2014). Determination and inference of eukaryotic transcription factor sequence specificity. Cell, 158(6), 1431-1443.

Wingender, E., Schoeps, T., Haubrock, M., Krull, M., & Dönitz, J. (2018). TFClass: expanding the classification of human transcription factors to their mammalian orthologs. Nucleic Acids Research, 46(D1), D343-D347.

Examples

data(human_tfs)
head(human_tfs)
#>              Gene     Symbol CISBP_family                    TFClass_superclass
#> 1 ENSG00000267179 AC008770.3      C2H2 ZF Zinc-coordinating DNA-binding domains
#> 2 ENSG00000267281 AC023509.3 bZIP,C2H2 ZF                         Basic domains
#> 3 ENSG00000233757 AC092835.1      C2H2 ZF Zinc-coordinating DNA-binding domains
#> 4 ENSG00000264668 AC138696.1      C2H2 ZF Zinc-coordinating DNA-binding domains
#> 5 ENSG00000101126       ADNP  Homeodomain              Helix-turn-helix domains
#> 6 ENSG00000101544      ADNP2  Homeodomain              Helix-turn-helix domains
#>                         TFClass_class
#> 1            C2H2 zinc finger factors
#> 2 Basic leucine zipper factors (bZIP)
#> 3            C2H2 zinc finger factors
#> 4            C2H2 zinc finger factors
#> 5                Homeo domain factors
#> 6                Homeo domain factors
#>                                                                                                                                                          TFClass_family
#> 1 Three-zinc finger Krüppel-related;Other factors with up to three adjacent zinc fingers;More than 3 adjacent zinc fingers;Factors with multiple dispersed zinc fingers
#> 2                                                                                                                                                           Jun-related
#> 3 Three-zinc finger Krüppel-related;Other factors with up to three adjacent zinc fingers;More than 3 adjacent zinc fingers;Factors with multiple dispersed zinc fingers
#> 4                                                                                                                                     More than 3 adjacent zinc fingers
#> 5                                                                                                                                                                 HD-ZF
#> 6                                                                                                                                                                 HD-ZF
#>         TFClass_source         DBD                     TF_assessment
#> 1 Inferred from CIS-BP     C2H2 ZF Likely to be sequence specific TF
#> 2              TFClass        bZIP                       Known motif
#> 3 Inferred from CIS-BP     C2H2 ZF Likely to be sequence specific TF
#> 4              TFClass     C2H2 ZF                       Known motif
#> 5              TFClass Homeodomain Likely to be sequence specific TF
#> 6              TFClass Homeodomain Likely to be sequence specific TF
#>              Binding_mode           Motif_status
#> 1 Monomer or homomultimer               No motif
#> 2 Monomer or homomultimer 100 perc ID - in vitro
#> 3 Monomer or homomultimer               No motif
#> 4 Monomer or homomultimer 100 perc ID - in vitro
#> 5 Monomer or homomultimer               No motif
#> 6 Monomer or homomultimer               No motif

# Count human TFs per TFClass class
se <- get_tf_counts(
    list(Human = human_tfs), scheme = "TFClass", level = "class"
)
